svg.text: Parse policy_json.command_groups
Stage maintenance window + slot/jitter policy
ReportCommandStatus(SYNC STARTED/FINISHED)
PATCH /event/{run_event_id} metadata: SYNC window/slot policy state
Apply OBSERVE sinks + remote_write settings
Probe Mimir metrics path
ReportCommandStatus(OBSERVE STARTED/FINISHED/FAILED)
PATCH /event/{run_event_id} metadata: command state + last exit
Run WIFI_SCAN with RF setup env
Persist WiFi outputs + RF context metrics
Forward numeric metrics through configured sink path
ReportCommandStatus(WIFI_SCAN STARTED/FINISHED/FAILED)
PATCH /event/{run_event_id} metadata: WIFI_SCAN command state
Run BLE_SCAN with RF setup env
Persist BLE outputs + RF context metrics
Forward numeric metrics through configured sink path
ReportCommandStatus(BLE_SCAN STARTED/FINISHED/FAILED)
PATCH /event/{run_event_id} metadata: command state + last exit
Run CAPTURE_CSI with RF setup env
Persist CSI outputs/evidence + RF context metrics
Forward numeric metrics through configured sink path
ReportCommandStatus(CAPTURE_CSI STARTED/FINISHED/FAILED)
PATCH /event/{run_event_id} metadata: CAPTURE_CSI state + evidence status
Record stdout/stderr/exit_code
ReportCommandStatus(SHELL STARTED/FINISHED/FAILED)
PATCH /event/{run_event_id} metadata: command state + last exit
Map command status to event metadata
PATCH /event/{run_event_id} metadata: command state projection
Dispatch next command from policy
Process B1 - Detailed Execution Runtime
